summary.text: Tracie Davis, a Democrat, represents District 5 in the Florida Senate, elected in 2022, and served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2016 to 2022, according to the Florida Senate.

paragraphs.text: The Senate lists Davis as born in Jacksonville, with a B.S. in elementary education from Edward Waters University (1994) and a master's in educational leadership from the University of North Florida (2001).
